candidate_verdict: UPHELD and now closed from IMO primary bytes rather than from adjudication alone. MEPC.353(78) and MEPC.354(78) were retrieved from IMO's own resolutions CDN and their operative clause 5 read: each expressly REVOKES its 2021 predecessor, MEPC.354(78) naming MEPC.339(76) in terms.
authority:
MEPC.353(78) clause 5 revokes the 2021 G2 (MEPC.337(76)); MEPC.354(78) clause 5 revokes the 2021 G4 "adopted by resolution MEPC.339(76)". Separately, MEPC.352(78) (G1) section 4.1 shows the CF chain: G1 does not tabulate CF, it adopts the EEDI calculation guidelines by reference. That REFINES the Tranche 4 P2-05 finding: the card's CF numbers were right and its citation was a real link in a real chain, one step short - so the correction states the chain rather than swapping the citation.

SOURCES RELIED ON: SRC-CII-G1-MEPC352-78, SRC-CII-G2-MEPC353-78, SRC-CII-G4-MEPC354-78, SRC-IMO-MEPC412-84-CII-G1.
